preconditions.description: n is a positive integer within the range [1, 10^9]

preconditions.expression: a1 >= 0 and a2 >= 0 and a3 >= 0 and a1 + a2 + a3 == n
preconditions.description: a1, a2, a3 are non-negative integers summing to n

preconditions.expression: b1 >= 0 and b2 >= 0 and b3 >= 0 and b1 + b2 + b3 == n
preconditions.description: b1, b2, b3 are non-negative integers summing to n

postconditions.description: Output consists of two integers: the minimum and maximum number of rounds Alice can win, with min_wins ≤ max_wins

postconditions.expression: min_wins == min(a3, b1) + min(a1, b2) + min(a2, b3)
postconditions.description: The minimum wins are calculated by summing the minimum of Alice's winning moves against Bob's losing moves for each possible winning combination (paper vs rock, rock vs scissors, scissors vs paper)

postconditions.expression: max_wins == min(a3, b1) + min(a1, b2) + min(a2, b3) + max(0, (a1 + a2 + a3) - (b1 + b2 + b3) - (min(a3, b1) + min(a1, b2) + min(a2, b3)))
postconditions.description: The maximum wins are calculated by summing the minimum of Alice's winning moves against Bob's losing moves for each possible winning combination, plus any remaining rounds where Alice can win by default (due to excess moves)
